name: n8n-rust-v4
description: n8n 2.9.4 anatomy → contract → reference runtime → LEGO isolation → (later) Rust replacement

scripts.isolation:check: node tools/workflow-boundary-map.mjs --check && node tools/workflow-kernel-conformance.mjs --check && node tools/workflow-port-surface.mjs --check && node tools/workflow-reference-manifest.mjs --check
scripts.verify:leaf-legos: bash -lc 'for p in packages/api-lego packages/binary-data-lego packages/connection-lego packages/credentials-lego packages/execution-data-lego packages/execution-engine-lego packages/persistence-lego packages/scheduler-lego packages/settings-lego packages/trigger-lego packages/webhook-lego; do echo "== $p =="; npm --prefix "$p" run build || exit $?; done'
